deviations: Run 1 (same day, discarded) dropped untouched levels before choosing each population, so placebos were kept only on sessions where their parent wall had been touched. That inflated placebo break rates to 60-64% and produced spurious wall-minus-placebo gaps of -7 to -14 pp. Found by a distance-matched diagnostic (pooled gap only -3 pp) before anything was written up; fixed so populations follow the prereg definition (neighbours of each real wall, same day, touched or not). Run 1 numbers are in RESULTS.md, Deviations.
